title: ScannedChecks
description: The tests a codebase carries and what each claims to verify, as one stack's scanner observed them. Produced by a per-stack adapter (Rust: `#[test]` fns under tests/; JVM: @Test methods; Node: runner tables), consumed by `rqunit trace`, which owns every judgment: traceability rules, the untraced burn-down, and the L14 new-test gate (base-vs-head set difference over these observations). A scanner reports what is; it never decides what is new, wrong, or excusable.

generated_by.description: Adapter name and version — names the scanner for anyone reading the artifact or an error that quotes it.

id.description: Stable, stack-qualified check id (Rust: `<package>::<file stem>::<fn>`), so the union across stacks never collides. Identity must survive a reformat — it is what RU verification refs resolve against.

path.description: Repo-relative file the check lives in, '/'-separated.

fn.description: The test's own name in its stack's vocabulary (function, method, or case name).

verifies.description: What the check claims to verify: RU ids from its trace annotation; ["infrastructure"] for the audited plumbing bucket; [] for an untraced check. The scanner transcribes the annotation — whether an id resolves, or an untraced check blocks, is the framework's judgment.
